title: Evening Flock — Begin two slow rings with following or opposed flights
help: All eighty birds start in the same two rings. Quarter-speed tangents follow together, reverse together, or oppose each other. The speed is a starting condition, not a promise of continued circling. Starting clears beat history and leaves the sky paused.
rows: Both rings take quarter-speed forward flights
Both rings take quarter-speed backward flights
message: rings experiments keep their distinct rules and exact supplied choices
